_comment: v4rian safety/* full lockdown. Pins safety/* creation to the allocator workflow's identity so only the atomic pool/safety pair allocation can mint a safety ref. update and deletion are blocked everywhere so under the stay-forever rule every anchor SHA is immutable for the life of the branch and no operator, workflow, or claim ceremony can ever drop a safety/ ref. Combined with the pool-creations ruleset this blocks the rename-equals-delete-plus-create attack vector for developers entirely. The include patterns cover both layouts: legacy flat refs/heads/safety/<suffix> and prefixed refs/heads/safety/<vYYYY.MAIN>/<suffix> from any historical anchor still on the repo. Apply via .io.v4rian.neo-git/scripts/apply-repo-rules.sh or bin/lockdown. The ACTOR_ID placeholder is substituted at apply time with the integration id of the GitHub Actions bot on the target repo (gh api /orgs/{org}/installations --jq '.installations[] | select(.app_slug=="github-actions") | .id'). Bypass actors: repository admins only; privileged transitions run locally under the admin operator's own gh session (bin/post-merge-lifecycle). Apply via .io.v4rian.neo-git/scripts/apply-repo-rules.sh.
name: v4rian-safety-lockdown
